threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the bus stop' instead of 'the bus shelter' and look confused when someone abbreviates that to 'the bus.'
Last night on the 59, a guy in a bright red onesie sang nursery rhymes the whole route. Had half the bus chuckling, and a few kids joining in!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids setting up a makeshift skate ramp in the courtyard, complete with graffiti sketches. That's when it felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you can spot murals painted over graffiti from the '90s. It’s like a living museum where history mingles with modern art, constantly evolving.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they cut through the crowd at the BART entrance, dodging tourists like they’re part of a busker's routine.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy on the 31 hauling a full mannequin dressed in a tuxedo. The look on everyone's face was priceless. Only in SF...

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss that our bars close early on weeknights—it's not just a party zone, but a neighborhood where sleep is sacred.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their excitement over the latest trendy tapas bar, while the locals still prefer that tucked-away place down a side street.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You say 'please' and 'thank you' to the bus drivers. You'll stop once you realize they don't even look up.
Last night on the 77, a guy serenaded the whole bus with a ukulele version of Spice Girls. Almost made the 30-minute wait for a bus home worth it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting in the park, I overheard kids arguing over who gets to be a pigeon today. That’s when I realized this place is a blend of chaos and charm.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find currywurst served up with a side of techno beats from the street, blending fast food and nightlife like nowhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they roll their eyes when someone tries to make eye contact on a crowded Muni bus.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 at Civic Center, and a whole yoga class decided to stretch in the aisle. Only in SF would that be a normal bus ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Gràcia' is just Gaudí and parks, but the real vibe’s in our local bars, where the same faces gather every night for a quiet drink.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a newbie by the way they take a picture of every menu item at local bars—definitely a dead giveaway!
